shap_procedure.explainer: shap.TreeExplainer(rf), defaults (feature_perturbation tree_path_dependent, model_output raw = class probabilities)
shap_procedure.data: imputed test set, 192 days, unscaled (imputer fit on the run's train part)
shap_procedure.aggregation: np.abs(shap_values).mean(axis=(0, 2)) on the (192, 19, 3) array: mean |SHAP| over samples and the 3 classes (identical to run_shap() in cap5_compare_algorithms_json_ext.py, the script behind Figure 2)
shap_procedure.rank: 1 = largest mean |SHAP|; ties -> smallest rank (scipy rankdata method min); top-5 = 5 largest values, stable tie-break by feature order

what_varies: RF random_state 0..n_runs-1; data and preprocessing (SMOTE seed 42) fixed
